policy.autoUpdateHint: Apply marketplace updates automatically when available.
policy.governanceHint: Warn lets unknown points pass with a diagnostic; Block rejects them outright.
policy.rateLimitsNote: Rate limits and sandbox defaults are configured globally and visible per-plugin in /plugins.
policy.securityPostureHint: Deny network egress for plugins that didn't declare an allowlist, and prompt for every declared permission. Off (balanced) keeps the default: dangerous permissions still prompt; plugins without a declared allowlist keep unrestricted egress.
policy.signatureRequiredHint: Refuse to load plugins without a verified publisher signature.
policy.trustedPublishersOnlyHint: Accept signatures only from the official key or publishers you trust; reject unknown signers.

scheduled.hint: Plugin-contributed scheduled jobs share the same governance surface as other scheduled tasks. Open the scheduler to manage cron, intervals, and confirmation policies.
